Optional: 1 seeded jalapeno pepper, chopped; 1 dash ground
cloves; 1 dash cayenne pepper

1. Simmer the chicken in the chicken broth for about 10 minutes.

2. While the chicken is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large saucepan
over medium heat. Stir in the chopped onion and cook until tender,
5 to 7 minutes.

3. Mix in the garlic, green chilies, cumin, (jalapeno, cloves, cayenne).
Continue to cook and stir until tender, about 3 minutes.

4. Add the onion and chili mixture into the chicken broth. Add the
beans, and bring to a boil.

5. Turn down heat and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes, stirring oc~
casionally. It should be a little soupy. To make the broth thicker, mash
about half of the beans using a potato masher.

6. Serve topped with grated cheese. If desired, garnish with cilantro,
salsa, chopped tomato, scallions, and avocado or guacamole. To
complete the meal, serve with fresh, warmed tortillas on the side.

Yield: 4 servings
NUTRITION INFORMATION: 1,700 total calories; 425 calories per serving; 38 g carbohydrate;
42 g protein; 12 g fat
